definition: A reusable arrangement without independent adoption or semantic authority.
A typed selectable behavior required or offered at a boundary.
A subsystem without a complete adoption, support and exit promise.
An observed provider artifact with no canonical semantic authority.
A reusable provider-neutral semantic or effect-port seam.
A separate bounded context imported through an explicit contract.
An independently adopted and operated user-outcome promise.
Owner of one meaning, identity, lifecycle, invariants and refusals.
An exact external edition specializing a contract.
Packaging of products and components without transferred ownership.
